list.name: segment
list.label: Segment
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT metric_json->>'segment' AS segment FROM metrics WHERE metric_json IS NOT NULL AND metric_json->>'segment' IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1;

list.name: project
list.label: Project
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT project FROM metrics WHERE project IS NOT NULL AND (CASE WHEN COALESCE('$segment','') = '' THEN TRUE ELSE metric_json->>'segment' = '$segment' END) ORDER BY 1;

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (project) project, COALESCE(score, metric_value) AS val FROM metrics WHERE metric_key='overall_maturity_score' AND (CASE WHEN COALESCE('$segment','') = '' THEN TRUE ELSE metric_json->>'segment' = '$segment' END) ORDER BY project, observed_at DESC) SELECT ROUND(AVG(val)::numeric,3) FROM latest WHERE (CASE WHEN COALESCE('${project:csv}','') = '' THEN TRUE ELSE project IN (${project:csv}) END);

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status='succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 1) AS success_rate FROM runs WHERE COALESCE(finished_at, started_at) >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' AND (CASE WHEN COALESCE('${project:csv}','') = '' THEN TRUE ELSE project IN (${project:csv}) END);

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (project) project, COALESCE(score, metric_value) AS val FROM metrics WHERE metric_key='overall_maturity_score' AND (CASE WHEN COALESCE('$segment','') = '' THEN TRUE ELSE metric_json->>'segment' = '$segment' END) ORDER BY project, observed_at DESC), maturity AS (SELECT ROUND(AVG(val)::numeric,3) AS actual FROM latest WHERE (CASE WHEN COALESCE('${project:csv}','') = '' THEN TRUE ELSE project IN (${project:csv}) END)), success AS (SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status='succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 1) AS actual FROM runs WHERE COALESCE(finished_at, started_at) >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' AND (CASE WHEN COALESCE('${project:csv}','') = '' THEN TRUE ELSE project IN (${project:csv}) END)) SELECT 'Maturity' AS kpi, m.actual AS actual, ${maturity_target}::numeric AS target, (m.actual - ${maturity_target}::numeric) AS delta FROM maturity m UNION ALL SELECT 'Success Rate %', s.actual, ${success_target}::numeric, (s.actual - ${success_target}::numeric) FROM success s;
